title: Test Bench Full React Parity And Jinja Removal

specify.notes: Created the active Spec 043 specification from the generated roadmap prompt. Scope covers full React parity and Jinja removal for test bench suites, cases, assertions, target selection, run launch/progress/results, artifacts, publish-gate evidence, audit timeline, safe execution modes, stale evidence prevention, and legacy direct-link behavior.

auto_clarifications: Backend-owned polling snapshots remain acceptable for run progress; React never infers pass/fail or terminal state from timers or partial client state.
Legacy artifact links redirect to React artifact metadata panels when authorized; raw payloads, storage paths, and local paths are never rendered.
Old suite, case, create, edit, and launch URLs redirect to React with tenant scope, ids, filters, saved-filter intent, breadcrumbs, and conflict state preserved when safe.
Suite runs and publish-gate evidence bind to backend-supplied current target revisions, and stale or copied evidence cannot satisfy publication.
Workflow builder and publish-gate panels link only to authorized React test bench evidence for the exact suite, run, target revision, and artifact references.
React may display approved probe summaries and policy evidence only; local and CI validation keep real probes denied or mocked unless an existing policy approval explicitly permits them.
Routes that cannot safely redirect return a non-Jinja safe problem or documented retirement response without revealing whether protected data exists.

plan.notes: Planned test bench React-only parity by retaining JSON APIs, converting legacy /admin/agent-tests/ui browser routes to React redirects or safe non-Jinja problems, preserving mutation form behavior with React redirects, deleting only agent_tests templates after evidence, and validating with dual-auth tests, route/import scanners, frontend tests, Spec QA, and Playwright.

tasks.notes: Generated dependency-ordered, file-specific tasks covering legacy test bench redirect/form-post compatibility, suite/case/run React parity, progress/result/trace/artifact/gate/audit safety, test-bench template deletion, docs, QA artifacts, generated assets, Spec QA, and Playwright validation.

analyze.notes: Spec, plan, and tasks cover test bench suite/case authoring, run launch/progress, result diagnostics, trace/artifact metadata, publish-gate evidence, audit timeline, safe execution modes, stale evidence rejection, legacy route redirects/form-post compatibility, template deletion evidence, dual-auth tests, QA docs, and Playwright validation. No CRITICAL or HIGH findings remain.

implement.notes: Converted legacy /admin/agent-tests/ui browser routes and form posts to React redirects, removed agent_tests Jinja templates, added redirect and retirement tests, extended React query-state handling, added unavailable artifact/gate states, regenerated TypeScript contracts, refreshed docs, and validated QA043 end to end.
